hero.hero_sub: Run Club by Golden Soul Club. We meet on Thursdays at 6:00 p.m. to rack up miles for the soul through the urban center of Río Piedras.

club.fact1_b: We start together right outside the store.
club.fact2_b: The shop doubles as a clubhouse. Show before 6:00 p.m., leave your bag in one of our lockers, and stay hydrated in our oasis.
club.fact4_t: Free, every week, open to everyone
club.fact4_b: Together, we keep racking up miles for the heart.

waiver.waiver_title: Release of Responsibility — Golden Soul Run Club
waiver.waiver_p1: Running and related physical activity carry inherent risks, including but not limited to falls, collisions with other participants, vehicles, or objects, adverse weather, road or trail conditions, and medical events such as cardiac or heat-related illness.
waiver.waiver_p2: By signing up, I confirm that I am physically able to participate and that I voluntarily assume all risks associated with this activity. I release Golden Soul Club, its owners, staff, and run leaders from liability for injury, loss, or damage arising from my participation, except where caused by gross negligence or intentional misconduct.
waiver.waiver_p3: I consent to receive emergency medical care if needed, and understand Golden Soul Club is not responsible for the cost of that care. I understand participation is voluntary and I may leave the group run at any time.
waiver.waiver_check_label: I have read and agree to the release of responsibility above.

footer.foot_tagline: In the pursuit of continued growth and balance. Miles for the soul. A concept store and running club in Río Piedras.
footer.foot_hours: Open Tuesdays through Saturdays, 12:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m.
